items.title: Carmen Leggio interviewed by Monk Rowe, Tarrytown, New York, October 31, 1998
items.q: Unless you get a hit like Stan Getz or whoever, like Benny Goodman.

ctx.x: Yeah, there’s not much money to be made in the little clubs.
Unless you get a hit like Stan Getz or whoever, like Benny Goodman. If you get a hit you’re okay. Otherwise jazz musicians struggle all their lives practically.
Did you have a particular group of people in Tarrytown that you worked with steadily before the service?
